sections.Profile:
The "Big Hunt" pinball machine, produced by Italian manufacturer A.M.I. in 1976, features a Western hunting theme. This electro-mechanical game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, six standup targets, a four-bank drop target, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: A.M.I.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Wedgehead, Native Americans, Horses, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
